tagline: A local Excel-like spreadsheet. Your workbook lives in the icon, not in anyone's cloud.
description:
A full spreadsheet: cells, formulas, formatting, freeze, sort, filter, comments, and as many sheets as you need. Type a budget, a roster, a grade book — it stays on this device, inside the app. There is no account and no server of theirs (or ours) that your numbers ever visit.

It opens on a small demo sheet so you can see formulas working, then it is yours. Every edit is saved a moment after you make it; close the app and come back, the grid is where you left it. New workbook wipes the grid, not the app.

An unofficial port of FortuneSheet by ruilisi, MIT-licensed. Their live collaboration is not in this app. What you type is saved here, not synced to a service.
